name: ship-log
description: /ship turns what you built this session into a build-in-public post for X or LinkedIn

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that writes the post: an alias (haiku, sonnet) or a full model id.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Optional. Each draft is POSTed here as JSON { platform, text, source: "ship-log" }, say to feed a content calendar.

webhookToken.title: Webhook bearer token
webhookToken.description: Optional. Sent as Authorization: Bearer <token> with the webhook POST.
